title: SeasonedRiceFarmer/rna-tools pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

fastq_1.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 1 must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

fastq_2.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 2 cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

vcf.errorMessage: Phased VCF must have extension '.vcf' or '.vcf.gz' and cannot contain spaces
vcf.description: This patient's own genotyped VCF, used for STAR's WASP filter and phASER downstream. WASP needs only the GT field (heterozygous SNVs), not phasing; phASER downstream does need it phased. Optional; only read when --wasp_ase is set.
